summary: First testing iteration of Warung Kopi POS MVP. Backend pytest suite (17 tests) all pass. Frontend critical flows all pass: login (admin/cashier), error message string display, POS product grid, add-to-cart, cash + QRIS payment, receipt rendering, cart clearing, stock refresh, role-based sidebar (cashier sees only Kasir+Riwayat, admin sees all 5), logout. History, Reports, Products, Categories pages all render with expected elements.

issues: Uses native HTML <input type='date'> for date filter (data-testid='reports-date-filter') instead of shadcn calendar/Popover. Browser default date picker styling is inconsistent with the rest of the modern design. Non-blocking but recommend switching to shadcn Calendar component for visual consistency.

Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent}' on all dialogs. Accessibility a11y warning only, no functional impact. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to fix.

action_items: (optional/minor) Add DialogDescription to Payment/Receipt/History dialogs to remove a11y warning.
(optional) Replace native <input type='date'> on Reports/History with shadcn Calendar+Popover for visual consistency.

(optional) Frontend computes tax with Math.round(subtotal*0.10) while backend uses round(., 2). For IDR (integer prices) results match, but if future prices become decimal, slight discrepancies could occur. Consider using same rounding approach.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Good — uses bcrypt for passwords, JWT in httpOnly cookie + Bearer fallback, _id excluded via projection, async/await used throughout, env vars used (no hardcoded values).
server.py seed_admin: idempotent and updates password_hash if changed — meets playbook expectation.
Stock decrement in /transactions is best-effort and not in a DB transaction; concurrent purchases could oversell stock. Not critical for MVP but should be flagged for production hardening.

/transactions filter by date uses string comparison on ISO timestamps stored as strings. Works correctly because created_at is stored as ISO string at line 315 ('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS...'). Stable but consider storing native datetime for index efficiency.

CORS: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject). Currently works because httpOnly cookie auth also has Bearer header fallback. Recommend explicit origins for production.
test_credentials: admin/admin123 (admin), kasir/kasir123 (cashier) — both verified working. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is currently empty (only contains comment header) — main agent should populate it with these credentials.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed needed. Backend auto-seeds 4 categories (Kopi, Non-Kopi, Pastry, Makanan) and 10 products on startup. Test created/deleted ephemeral TEST_ prefixed product and category and several transactions (ORD20260611-0001 through ORD20260611-0004).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All MVP flows are functional. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pos_backend.py covers auth, categories, products, transactions (incl. tax/change/stock), role-based access, and reports. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pos_backend.py -v. Frontend Playwright covered: login, POS cash payment, POS QRIS payment, role-based sidebar, history, reports KPIs+chart, products/categories admin CRUD pages render. Mobile FAB (data-testid='mobile-cart-fab') was not tested at mobile viewport in this iteration.
